## Forms · Create Position Change Request → `n8n_createPositionChangeRequest(actor, data, options)`
Real `submitPositionChangeRequest` → `CHANGE_…` workflow (sheet *Position Changes*) → HR approval. Keys are the **raw HTML names** of PositionSiteChangeRequest.html.
**Required** (r2, verified): `firstName lastName currentClass(Hourly|Salary) effDate(yyyy-MM-dd) siteName(reference.sites)`
**Optional exposed:** `reqName reqEmail reqDate changeType[] currentTitle currentManagerName/Email siteOld siteNew titleOld titleNew classOld classNew mgrOld*/mgrNew* jrReq jrTitle(reference.jrs) sys[] equip[] rem[] equipRem[] comments`; the rest (department, receivingManagerEmail, google*, adp*, boss*, jonasJobs, purchasingSites, computer*, creditCard*, phone*, attachment*) via `extra`.
`changeType` ⊂ Site Transfer, Position Change, Classification, Manager Change (arrays; dual-lists adpSites/purchasingSites/bossComm/bossCostJobs/jonasJobs are **CSV strings**; adpSalaryAccess/creditCard* are strings "Yes"|"").
`reqEmail` falls back to the session principal. Returns `{ workflowId, message }`. **Authorization ≠ attribution:** role checks run against the real Execution API session (`efx-bot@team-group.com`); `actor` is recorded for attribution only.

### Attribution
Pass `actor` from the calling workflow so Forms records who did it, e.g.
`{{ { id: 'n8n:' + $workflow.name, email: 'efx-bot@team-group.com', display: $workflow.name + ' (n8n)' } }}`
If omitted the Router attributes the call to itself. `idempotencyKey` (optional) makes a retry replay the first result for 10 min.
Errors throw as `EFX <CODE>: message` — attach an error output or error workflow on the calling node.
